notes.subject: נסס
notes.rationale: Verb נסס occurs only here in the Tanakh; rendered as wasting sickness, 'going down'.

notes.subject: כמסס נסס
notes.rationale: KJV reads 'as when a standard-bearer fainteth' (repointing massōs nōsēs); JPS 'as when a sick man wasteth away' — the latter followed.

notes.subject: laip
notes.rationale: נפש is life-force/breath, not 'soul' in a later sense; Tok Pisin 'laip' keeps the life reading.

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ bai pinisim glori bilong bus bilong en, na bilong gaden frut bilong en, long laip i go inap long mit; na bai i kamap olsem man i sot nogut long sik.
